## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the bounded change, why it matters, and one concrete before/after case.

## Scope and provenance

- [ ] Original local work; no private code, real data, credentials, or host paths.
- [ ] No external integration, database, account, infrastructure, or execution access.
- [ ] Dataset ID, exact hashes, source version, and split exposure are disclosed.
- [ ] All development trials and failed evidence are retained; holdout was not used for tuning.
- [ ] Results are labeled synthetic engineering evidence with no market/alpha claims.

## Validation

List exact commands and actual results. Include targeted causal timing, cost,
missing-data, contract, and custody tests where affected. State whether any holdout
attempt was consumed. Distinguish local checks from actual hosted CI results.

## Review and limitations

Explain assumptions, remaining model limits, and data/code rights. Review changes
to workflows and their tests together. Confirm read-only token, hosted runners,
pinned actions, no PR secrets, and no privileged PR trigger. This template does
not authorize push, hosting, release, deployment, or financial action.
